create_EQACNNPretrainDataset: create an EQACNNPretrainDataset instance with a Habitat config for training or validation mode
save_frames_to_lmdb: save rgb, depth, and semantic segmentation frames from shortest path positions to an LMDB database
load_scene_in_simulator: load a new scene into the Habitat simulator by reconfiguring the environment with the scene path
getitem_rgb_depth_seg: retrieve a batch of rgb, depth, and segmentation tensors from the LMDB cache by index
cache_exists_check: check if the EQA-CNN pretrain dataset cache directory exists and contains data
